verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a business finance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no assistant inside the Airwallex product. AgentOS and the developer connectors let external AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) reach the account or docs; those are developer building blocks for outside agents, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
